description: Show clothing on a model without a booking. AI virtual try-on turns a flat-lay or hanger photo into a realistic on-model view for your listing and social ads.
h1: AI Virtual Try-On for Clothing: Your Garment on a Model
lead: Shoppers skip clothing they can only see flat, while booking a model for every arrival is expensive. Upload one garment photo and get an on-model view for listings and social ads.
benefits_h2: Why sellers choose AI virtual try-on for clothing

benefits.t: Show the garment on a body
benefits.d: Flat lays cannot show where the hem falls or how sleeves sit. The model view answers those questions from one uploaded photo, so buyers can judge the piece before choosing a size.

benefits.t: New arrivals on models the week they land
benefits.d: Each garment gets a person and a believable room without coordinating a shoot. Your new-in collection can show clothes being worn rather than hanging on a rail.

benefits.t: Front and back views on demand
benefits.d: Run a second version from a back source or a clear back description to show collar and rear seams. You give shoppers both sides without asking anyone to pose twice.
The square photo sits beside your existing flat lays on the product page and works in launch posts. Add your real measurements and size chart as text after download.

faq.q: What is an AI virtual try-on template?
faq.a: It is a ready-made fashion scene. Add a garment photo and generate an on-model view for a listing, campaign or social post.

faq.q: Do I need to write prompts to use these templates?
faq.a: No. Pick a style, upload your garment photo and generate. Step two can include one short line about the scene if you want.

faq.q: Who are these clothing templates built for?
faq.a: Clothing sellers, ecommerce teams and agencies that need on-model product photos without arranging a model shoot.

faq.q: Can I use a flat-lay or hanger photo?
faq.a: Yes. Use a clear flat-lay or hanger photo that shows the full garment and its main details.

faq.q: Will the model wear my exact garment?
faq.a: The result uses your uploaded garment as the reference. Check the shape, color, seams and closures against the physical piece before publishing.

faq.q: Can I make several views from one garment photo?
faq.a: Yes. Reuse the source across mirror, walk and lookbook scenes to create another view without a second shoot.

faq.q: How fast is a try-on photo made?
faq.a: A photo is generated in minutes after you start the job, with no casting, studio day or reshoot in between.

faq.q: What does a virtual try-on photo cost?
faq.a: Each photo costs 24 credits, and the charge is shown before the job starts.

faq.q: Can I use a try-on image in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no AIVideosUGC watermark and can run in your own ads, pages and posts. You remain responsible for product claims and disclosures.

visual.overview: A virtual try-on scene puts your garment on a model so shoppers can see the silhouette before opening the size chart.

steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. An adult model wears the garment and turns once in soft daylight to show the full silhouette, collar, sleeves, pockets and hem. Keep the pose relaxed and leave enough space for the complete outline. Natural fashion UGC look, eye-level handheld framing, one gentle push-in. Sound: fabric movement, no music. End facing camera with the garment centered for a listing review. Keep the background quiet and leave a clean edge around the garment for a listing crop.
